notes.author_own_uncertainty: No separate verbal uncertainty or question mark is recovered. The exact manuscript assertion Alors je dis qu'on a is retained. The unsure annotations belong to this reading.
notes.title_date_page_counts: Title Cas particuliers has one underline. No date or separate manuscript page number is recovered. Pencilled archive numeral 16 is recorded only as the prescribed comment, with hand undetermined.
notes.mathematics_led_reading_decisions: The complement in the opening parenthesis is X setminus Sigma_i as visibly written. The lower transverse union stroke and all doubtful indices are preserved from their own strokes. No mathematical correspondence, proof, numerical geometry comparison, or algebraic repair was used to choose a reading.
notes.H_apparatus: H page{16} is its page identifier. H note about X setminus Sigma_i and X setminus E_i is editorial apparatus. H emph on the heading conveys the same single emphasis span. H add/struck correspond to insertion/deletion conventions. H uncertain{Pour} adds no independent difference after the word is recovered.
notes.C_scope: Only the actual Doubtful readings section provides the source doubt identities. Its row 7 qualifies the earlier Sigma even without a C.tex unsure macro; row 8 also covers the second raised ring. Each row and separately named local part is mapped above. The next-sheet words in row 10 were not used.
notes.image_workflow: Whole scan viewed once for layout; half a once and half b once for full line-by-line reading; all fourteen created crop images viewed once each. No image was reopened after its decision. Crop 14 was added for unresolved accent presence, without remaking another crop.
notes.crop_boundaries: All deciding target continuations are retained. Crop 05 includes a small edge trace from adjacent main writing near Soit; it supplies no extra marginal word. Crops 02, 09, 10, 11 and 12 contain clipped neighbouring context at their boundaries, while their stated target loci and target endpoints remain in view.
notes.graphic_coordinates: All local TikZ paths use x=0.01cm and y=-0.01cm, a fixed source origin, and an explicitly declared drawing rectangle. Observed locus boxes are recorded separately from path control points, rectangles and font extents. Inline text uses base-west anchors with zero inner and outer separation. M03 uses the explicitly declared (47,3) translation from outer origin (1145,1624), with its own fixed inner baseline. Coordinate choices and paths are manual visual approximations; no curve-extrema, fitting or image-difference computations were performed.
